description: Search the postgres source at any commit, branch, tag or date (or across history), from the code-history index: every line of every commit, byte-exact. A literal by default; match=regex for a PostgreSQL regex (^ and $ are per line; \b \< \> as in grep), match=identifier for any of snake_case/CamelCase/UPPER spellings. File sets agree with `git grep -l` at the same commit. Results name the resolved sha and ref. complete=false means the totals are lower bounds (cut says why). With history (all | <rev> | A..B) it returns every matching line any commit in the range had, with the commit that added it and the one that removed it.

context.description: Lines of context around each match (0-20, default 0)

history.description: Search history instead of one commit: all, a rev (everything up to it on its line), or A..B (B's line after A, as git log A..B)

include.description: Path globs to keep, e.g. *.c, src/include/**/*.h

output.description: lines (default): each matching line with its number; files: paths with match counts; counts: [path, count] pairs

paths.description: Directories or globs to search under, e.g. src/backend/storage

query.description: Text, regex or identifier to find

repository.description: Repository; only postgres is in the code-history index for now (the default).

version.description: Commit to read: a SHA or 7+ hex prefix, a branch (master, REL_17_STABLE), a tag (REL_17_0), a major (17, 9.6), a release (17.2), <ref>@YYYY-MM-DD (the branch's last commit by that day), or <ref>~N. Default: the newest release branch's head.

name: code_search
